🟠🟠 v 🔵⚪️

New Mills v Sandbach United

Alfie Carmichael makes his debut today for The Bach and Max Williams starts. Let’s go Bach and keep the cup run going!
Saturday sees the Ramblers take a short break from the league as we seek a place in the last 8 of the Edward Case Cup with a tough away fixture @NewMillsFC . https://t.co/fTTupmwvxu
A fantastic 6 goals on the road and a great 3 points to maintain our position at the top of the table, get in The Bach and enjoy your Saturday evening, we will! https://t.co/AiNzHxnYa9

🔵⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Telford Town v Sandbach United

Finishes here Telford Town 0 The Bach 6 with three second half goals from hat-trick hero Foley, Hatton and Birchall.  In defence The Bach were solid and rewarded with a clean sheet and going forward we were ruthless, get in The Bach!!!
